note: The bands the SIG Kadet Senior plant has to land in, from docs/KADET-STAGE1.md, which derives each from SIG's published figures, O.S.'s for the FS-52 Surpass, an owner's measured rpm on its 12 x 6 and the drawn model (scripts/kadet-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Bombshell's in proportion about its derived figure, which is the Slow Stick's, unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick, which is 81 percent of the engine's rpm, derived 18.60, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 14.58 on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.860 to 1.165 of it: the cruise SIG trims the Kadet at, 'with the model flying at about 3/4 throttle, feed in down trim until the model flies level'

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 7.15; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.15 / 5.029, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.533 (scripts/kadet-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.029: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.22867369258301848. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.150 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.121, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.150 / 1.271) = 0.9514.

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 23.12, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 18.28 on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.910 to 1.123 of it

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds the plant flies unstalled, derived 7.78 at 13.1 m/s, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 4.92 at 10.1 on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.681 to 1.199 of it, and the sweep moved with the best speed, 1.1 under it to 2.9 over as it was

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at cruise, every stick centred: the four state lateral model gives 25.7, 22.4 and 19.4 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s at the 18.60 m/s cruise, a spiral that halves the bank in 9.9 s (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): 25.7, 22.5 and 19.7 at 14.58 m/s on the straight line), the band in the same proportion, 0.462 to 1.548 of it; the bank at 6 s, the same side, and never steeper than it started. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the combined plant (w36-physics): the lateral model carried no prop. Flown as the Slow Stick's (kadet:derive bankAfterFlown: the longitudinal model alongside, the fin in the wash, the prop's torque and swirl with its force on the whole stream, 1/2 rho (u + 2 v_i), Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b; scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl): 21.4, 14.4 and 9.6 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s at 19.78 m/s; SIG: 0 right thrust. The same 0.462 to 1.548 of it, 4.5 to 14.8 (was 9 to 30 about 19.4); the plant flies 23.3 at 2 s and 11.9 at 6 s.

s7_rudder_bank.source: full right roll stick, which is full right rudder, from level cruise: 26.4 deg after 1 s by the lateral model at the 18.60 m/s cruise, right wing down (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): 20.3 at 14.58 m/s on the straight line), the band in the same proportion, 0.611 to 1.522 of it

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the rudder at full throttle: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, the Cub's 15 percent, and the radius itself against the 53.9 m the level turn flies at 23.0 m/s with 1.1 deg of up elevator, within the same 15 percent, and thrown at that speed (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): 33.2 m at 18.1 m/s with 1.8 deg on the straight line)

s9_stall_power_off.source: Entered 2026-10-11 as FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5 Full Stalls, Power-Off sets it up, a stabilised idle descent at the normal approach speed, 1.3 times the middle of S2's band, then full up (scripts/*-gates.js S9a quotes it); was entered from cruise, which the prop curves raised by a fifth. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on scripts/lib/liftcurve.js brought up to the plant's sourced model (the wing stalling on its own slope a_w, the tail's share lifting on past it, the finite wing's broadside normal force 1.11 + 0.018 AR of Viterna and Janetzke NASA TM-82944 with B2, where it had the whole aircraft's slope and the infinite plate's 2.0): the full up mush at 13.5 deg, 7.52 m/s sinking 1.085 (was 12.8 deg, 7.86 m/s, 1.18), within 25 percent (was 0.89 to 1.47). full up from level flight at 1.2 Vs, 8.58 m/s, throttle closed, held 16 s (the Bombshell's 8 s scaled by the two phugoids, 10.1 s against 5.6) and read over the last 2 s: the pitching moment, taken back through the stall (the post stall model of docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), trims at 13.6 deg of alpha and the aircraft settles into a mush at 7.72 m/s sinking 1.21 m/s, within 25 percent. Re-derived 2026-10-08 on the plant's curve with CL max at its top (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the curve the band was first derived on peaked at 0.88 of the Kadet's CL max of 1.15, so the mush sank 1.88 m/s at 9.0; no wing drop, no yaw that is a spin, the nose never plunging Re-derived 2026-10-11 when the curves (w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e) moved the cruise to 18.60 m/s and with it Cm0, which trims level there with the elevator neutral, 0.0783 to 0.0494: the mush trims at 12.85 deg of alpha, 7.86 m/s sinking 1.18 m/s (kadet:derive, full up mush), the band 25 percent either side of it as before; and the hold scaled by the same rule to the Kadet's phugoid on the curve, 14.07 s against 10.06 (kadet:derive), 16 s to 22 s: the plant's mush still swings at 16 s and has settled by 22. The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source.

s9_stall_power_on.source: re-derived 2026-10-11 to FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5, Full Stalls, Power-On, quoted in wingpilot.js faaPowerOnStall: held coordinated on the rudder until the stall, recognised and recovered (elevator neutral, wings on the rudder, power kept), never on its back, the wings level within the bank limit by the time the speed is back and held (the handbook returns to the flightpath with sufficient airspeed); was: full up held for the whole run with the wings within 15 deg on the rudder, the prolonged stalled condition the handbook says to prevent, which past the stall a rudder cannot hold since the wing's dihedral share fades (TP-2011 fig. 51). Before: the same with the throttle opened to 0.35 of the stick, where the 12 x 6 at 9 m/s pulls 4.06 N against the mush's 5.25 N of drag, 0.77 of it as half throttle pulled on the straight line (4.3 N against 5.6). Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): half throttle there pulls 7.22 N, more than the drag, and climbs the Kadet at full up hanging on its prop, which is not a stall (kadet:derive, at 9 m/s); held 22 s as S9a is, scaled to the phugoid on the curve; the premise, power under the mush's drag, is kept and the throttle that gives it re-derived: no wing drop, no spin, no plunge. Not the Bombshell's cruise throttle, where the FS-52 pulls 9.8 N, climbs the Kadet at full up and hangs it on its prop, which is not a stall. 2026-10-08 (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, the stall part 1): flown as the handbook flies a power on stall, the wings held level on the rudder (FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5); with the slipstream's swirl a tractor turns left there with the rudder left alone. The bands are as they were. The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source.

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the 18.60 m/s cruise, derived 14.07, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 10.06 at 14.58 m/s on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.822 to 1.169 of it. Trimmed hands off: the plant flies it at its table's Cm0, which has to be the derivation's 0.0494 for the trim to be at that cruise

s11_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.349, the 12 x 6's shaft power at a power coefficient of 0.045 0.579; the Bombshell's band about the two

s12_chop.source: throttle to idle from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

s13_throw.source: the manual's hand launch: 'run into the wind at a fast trot and thrust the model forward with the nose slightly up in a spear throwing motion. It is not necessary to achieve a lot of velocity ... The model may dip slightly and then should begin to climb at a slight angle'. Thrown at 9 m/s, 1.26 Vs, 5 deg nose up at full throttle, the elevator that holds level flight's angle of attack at 9 m/s at the throw's full throttle, the prop's wash over the stabiliser in it (kadet:derive, the hand launch: 4.80 deg, stick 0.438; 7.18 deg and 0.611 before the wash, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md; re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e) and its Cm0, 0.0494: was 4.51 deg and 0.415 on the straight line) and every other stick centred: after 3 s it has not dipped the 1.5 m from the hand to its wheels touching, and it is over 1.2 Vs

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, level, the CG 0.3072 m up; with the engine idling its 1.63 N held back by the wheels at the ground and its thrust line's moment lean it onto the nose wheel, 28.7 percent of the weight and 0.34 deg nose down (kadet:derive, at rest idling), within half a degree and 5 mm

s15_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass from standing, the elevator eased up from 1.1 Vs as the manual's 'a lot of elevator application is required for liftoff': it lifts off between 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, and between the rolls to those speeds at the rest attitude, 3.71 and 7.39 m (kadet:derive), re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 4.42 and 9.63 m on the straight line

s16_landing.source: a glide from 8 m at idle, flown down at 1.3 V_s, 9.3 m/s, on the elevator and flared from 1.2 m: touches under the Bombshell's margin over the stall, 1.23 V_s, and comes to rest on its three wheels at S14's attitude, no hull or prop

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, all from main's module at 512f915, before the Kadet existed The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was. Re-pinned 2026-10-12 (w37-flat-fall, the flat fall on its side, plant_wing.c fin_in_wake, the fin's saturated share in its wake loss, the sideslip moments at |cos_b|): bombshell (was 7ff9f99b7a63f16e): on its wheels at walking speed, sideways past 30 deg and the flow from behind; bramorChute (was 9302c46f4449de8b): its chute descent meets the flow from behind the wing, past 90 deg, where the sideslip moments no longer turn over. Re-pinned 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side): the recordings that fly sideways moved with their fuselage's crossflow drag taken on the drawn sections, not a round body's (side_cda, NACA TN 3038 through scripts/lib/crossflow.js), and with the AS3X gains re-derived on it (as3x:derive) (were f025098b3e73e796, e414025462e90c74, 0e223d63dcbee9b5, 7ff9f99b7a63f16e, a37fb4874100db9a, 04d5880268b8b3a4).

s18_cross_host.source: the Kadet's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

s20_idle.source: the throttle closed on the strip: the carburettor idles the FS-52 at O.S.'s lowest practical 2,300 rpm, 24.2 percent of the 9,500 it turns the 12 x 6 at, within 5 percent, and its 1.63 N of static thrust is under the 2.14 N of the wheels' rolling resistance, so the engine turns and the wheels' friction holds the aircraft: its ground speed is nil

s21_hands_off_glide.source: level at cruise, then the throttle closed and every stick let go, in Manual: the idle's thrust is nil past 7.9 m/s, 1.36 times its 5.8 m/s pitch speed, and the neutral elevator's pitching moment trims the glide at 2.1 deg of alpha, CL 0.185, 17.59 m/s sinking 4.14 m/s (kadet:derive, hands off glide; re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): the cruise and with it the Cm0 that trims there moved, 0.0783 to 0.0494; it was 3.3 deg, 14.08 m/s and 2.32 m/s on the straight line, and the first re-derivation's 2.9 deg, 15.16 m/s and 2.79 m/s was the derivation's search stopping at its 0.05 rad floor, under which this trim lies). The mean of 7 to 21 s, after the phugoid's first cycle: 5 to 15 s scaled to the phugoid the curves moved, 14.07 s against 10.06 (kadet:derive); the sink band is S3's in proportion, the speed band S1's, and it never reaches the stall's alpha

stab_letgo.source: kadet:stab in Manual: 1.5 s of full right roll stick from cruise at 75 percent (the rudder, 38.2 deg on the plant), then every stick let go: the bank 8 s later over the bank let go. The flown model (kadet:derive bankAfterFlown from 38.2 deg: the longitudinal model alongside, the lateral model at each step, the fin in the wash, the prop's torque and swirl with its force on the whole stream, scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl; SIG: 0 right thrust) gives 26.79, 17.38 and 7.74 deg after 2, 4 and 8 s, 0.203 of it. The plant flies 29.33, 19.66 and 10.37 (w36-physics), within 2.63 deg along the curve, 0.069 of the bank. Held within 0.137 of it either way: the worst agreement and the same again. Was: 0.3 to 0.8 of it, about the spiral alone halving a bank in 9.9 s (0.57 after 8 s) with no prop, red at 0.27 since the swirl's force at speed (w36-wash-speed 24a09a0d1).

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 14.5 m/s, 30 m up, 0.736 throttle (stab_trim_throttle, the stick stab:glide gives for level), every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Stabilised's loops with ArduPilot's roll integrator: derived 4.82 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.000 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 4.82 m), the bank within 0.000 deg and the heading within 0.000 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.000 m of the derived 1.76. Held within 0.01 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 18 m off the line, a figure with no source. SIG: 0 right thrust (docs/KADET-STAGE1.md). The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 18.37 m/s, the plant 18.37, within 0.000 along the curve, held within 0.01.
